guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails to build due to npm version compatibility issues. The error log shows: 'npm error code EBADENGINE', 'Not compatible with your version of node/npm: npm@12.2.2', and 'Required: {"node":"^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0"}', but currently installing Node.js v18.20.8 with npm 10.8.2. The setup script installs Node.js 18.x which is deprecated and incompatible with the latest npm version required. The npm install -g npm@latest command fails because the npm version demanded requires a Node.js version 22 or higher. To fix this, update the Dockerfile to install a newer supported Node.js version such as 22.x or 24.x from Nodesource or official sources instead of 18.x. Adjust the setup commands accordingly, for example, use https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x instead of setup_18.x. This will address node and npm version incompatibilities and allow the Dockerfile build to succeed.
